interpretationNotes: Raw target candidates include 13px checkboxes whose surrounding labels are 44px hit targets. They are not counted as small targets.
Targets outside a viewport in intentional scroll surfaces are not automatically clipping defects.
One confirmation harness outside-click check clicked the breadcrumb and navigated away. Its selector timeout is not an application error.
Axe reports repeated avatar-initial label mismatches and optional landmark/heading checks. These are not individually counted as product defects.
